# Lineages ban list (BUG-9329, decision 7Z A). Shipped with the mod; read at every game start.
# Creations on this list are moved out of each player's Lineages Cache into its "banned" folder (never deleted),
# never imported, offered or kept again, and the game never picks them again (visiting ships, NPCs).
# A player's own creations are never touched. Lines:
#   source <identity>     every creation whose recorded source is that hidden Lineages identity (a test profile)
#   creation <sha256>     one creation (the SHA-256 of its PNG, as the cache names it)
#   keep <sha256>         never banned, even from a listed source (a real creation a test profile copied)
# Identities and hashes only: no player names here.
